# SaaS Accelerator Bootstrap

Uses the Commercial Marketplace SaaS Accelerator patterns as a foundation.

## Scope

- Deploy accelerator components and required backing services.
- Configure marketplace integration points (landing pages, webhook endpoints).
- Establish extension boundaries where product code should be added.
- Align data model and events to tenant lifecycle and billing.

## Deliverables

- Accelerator baseline architecture map.
- Customization backlog (must-have vs optional).
- Cutover plan from sample flows to production-ready flows.
